image_description: A vintage green Olympia typewriter sits on a wooden desk. The image features the full keyboard, carriage, and body of the typewriter. In the background, there are framed pictures or advertisements and a box of 'Ritter Sport' chocolate. To the left, there is a glass inkwell or paperweight.
